title: Heard: the stream stalls with Block on, note errors, and an is-it-working watcher

text: Two bugs and one new tool, all going to minions now. Block is stopping the message stream as well as reloads, which I wrongly told you it would not; the reload hold minion is already in that file and gets the fix. The unknown verb note errors come from my new note lines, which the older pages do not know; a small fix. And a watcher that loads the pages being edited in a hidden browser after every change and tells the agent who made the edit about any error at once: being briefed now, with a daily log that archives itself.
